blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper, we present 1020 Group's submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了1020个小组向WMT26提出的自动化质量评价共同任务。 我们的系统Pterodactyl是专门为分任务2和3设计的,即分层质量分数预测和检测无出错分. Pterodactyl是一个高度自定义的,超低成本的系统,在翻译分类和数据校正中为二进制分类进行了优化. 它以LLM-as-a-judge方法为基础,在ROC分析的指导下进行即时工程和模型选择. 我们还开发出几种特地被改造为分任务3的变种.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent WMT competitions, reference-free quality estimation (QE) systems based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach have gained increasing traction for automated translation quality evaluation Lavie et al. (2025) ; Freitag et al. (2024) ; Zerva et al. (2024) . However, the development and deployment of such systems can be complex and costly. Here, we develop an efficient, production-oriented strategy for pushing the cost-performance frontier of automated translation evaluation: achieving better task-specific performance with faster and cheaper models and prompt configurations.
blocks.zh: 在近期的WPT竞赛中,基于LLM-as-a-judge方法的无参考质量估计系统在自动翻译质量评价Lavie等人(2025年);Freitag等人(2024年);Zerva等人(2024年)方面获得了越来越多的动力。 然而,开发和部署这种系统可能既复杂又昂贵。 在这方面,我们制定了高效、注重生产的战略,以推进自动翻译评价的成本-业绩前沿:通过更快、更便宜的模型和快速配置,实现更好的具体任务业绩。

blocks.en: Below, we present 1020 Group’s submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, and its variants are intended as highly customizable, ultra-low-cost, and robust options for performing segment-level score prediction (WMT26 automated quality evaluation subtask 2) and detecting error-free segments (WMT26 automated quality evaluation subtask 3). The system is highly customizable thanks to an efficient, streamlined engineering process that can be implemented to select and build fit-for-purpose QE systems for different application scenarios. When possible, we avoid separately optimizing every component when a shared screening criterion might suffice. Pterodactyl and its variants are also ultra-low-cost, in terms of both time and tokens, because our approach allows us to minimize cost and latency when two or more options show similar performance on test data. Finally, our approach allows engineering a system that remains relatively stable in different testing scenarios and under variations in the gold standard caused by inter-annotator disagreement.
blocks.zh: 下面,我们介绍1020个小组提交WMT26关于自动化质量评价的共同任务。 我们的系统Pterodactyl及其变体是作为高度定制、超低成本和强有力的选项,用于进行分区级分数预测(WMT26自动化质量评价分任务2)和检测无误段(WMT26自动化质量评价分任务3)。 该系统高度定制,因为可以实施高效、精简的工程流程,为不同的应用情景选择和建立适合目的的QE系统。 在可能的情况下,当共同筛选标准可能足够时,我们避免单独优化每个组成部分。 Pterodactyl及其变体在时间和符号方面也是超低成本的,因为我们的方法允许我们在两个或两个以上选项在测试数据上显示类似性能时将成本和耐久性降到最低. 最后,我们的方法允许在不同的测试情景中以及在由各通知人之间的分歧导致的金本位差异下,设计一个相对稳定的系统。

blocks.en: 2 The Pterodactyl Premise
blocks.zh: 2 Pterodactyl 精液

blocks.en: Our approach is based on the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, whereby our prompt engineering methodology and the selection of the most suitable models were guided by Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis Fawcett (2006) , supplemented by additional considerations. Our goal was to engineer a robust system that is simple to implement and adapt as well as sufficiently low-cost to be used in large production runs.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法基于LLM-as-a-judge的范式,根据这一范式,我们的快速工程方法和最合适的模型的选择以接收者操作特征分析(ROC)为指导,并辅之以其他考虑。 我们的目标是设计一个能够简单实施和适应的强大系统,以及足够低的成本用于大型生产运行。

blocks.en: 2.1 Basic Considerations
blocks.zh: 2.1 基本考虑

blocks.en: To develop our system, we started with commercially available general-purpose models and performed prompt engineering based on the considerations detailed below.
blocks.zh: 为了发展我们的系统,我们开始采用商业上可用的通用模型,并根据下文详述的考虑迅速进行工程。

blocks.en: Our starting point was the basic premise that a QE system that is able to separate good and bad translations well is a promising candidate for WMT26 subtasks 2 and 3. We have shown in Garland and Berger (2026) that ROC analysis provides an efficient screening tool to find such candidates among a pool of systems. Prompt and model selection for subtasks 2 and 3 can therefore be partially unified with this ROC screening method.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是基本的前提,即一个能够把好翻译和坏翻译很好地分开的QE系统是WMT26子任务2和3的有希望的人选. 我们已在Garland和Berger(2026年)中表明,ROC分析提供了一个有效的筛选工具,在一系列系统中找到这些候选人。 因此,可部分统一次级任务2和3的即时和模型选择,采用这种ROC筛选方法。

blocks.en: We tested the following additional considerations during our prompt engineering iterations for both subtasks 2 and 3: • Whether newer (larger) frontier models are better for translation quality estimation • Whether more reasoning improves estimation performance
blocks.zh: 我们在两个次级任务2和3的快速工程迭代过程中测试了下列其他考虑: · 较新的(较大)前沿模型是否更适合翻译质量估计 · 更多推理是否改善了估计性能

blocks.en: Whether newer (larger) frontier models are better for translation quality estimation
blocks.zh: 较新的(较大)前沿模型对翻译质量估计是否更好

blocks.en: Whether more reasoning improves estimation performance
blocks.zh: 更多推理是否改善了估计性能

blocks.en: 2.2 Further Considerations for Subtask 3
blocks.zh: 2.2 对分项目3的进一步审议

blocks.en: For subtask 3, further considerations come into play. Here, translations are to be triaged into error-containing and error-free segments, with a human gold standard obtained via contrastive error span annotation (cESA) Zouhar et al. (2026) . Submissions for subtask 3 are evaluated and ranked with reference to this cESA gold standard, as measured by the Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). Since cESA is a new human annotation method for which no extensive development data is available, our strategy was to optimize our system for robustness with respect to the exact score threshold that separates the error-free class from the error-containing one.
blocks.zh: 对于次级任务3,还有进一步的考虑。 在这里,翻译要三进制为包含错误和无错误的片段,人类金本位通过对比性错误在注释之间获得(cESA) 邹哈尔等 (2026). 按照Matthews 关联系数(MCC)的衡量标准,对分任务3的提交材料进行了评估,并参照该标准进行排名。 由于cESA是一种新的人类注解方法,没有广泛的开发数据,因此我们的战略是优化我们的系统,使其在准确的分数阈值上保持稳健,把无误类与含误类区分开来。

blocks.en: Figure 1: ROC curves (left) and MCC versus error-classifying threshold curves (right) for two example systems.
blocks.zh: 图1: ROC曲线(左)和MCC相对于两个实例系统的错误分类阈值曲线(右).

blocks.en: What do we mean by robustness? Past WMT tasks used standard error span annotation (ESA) Kocmi et al. (2024) , with slightly different guidelines and anchor specifications (see, e.g. Lavie et al. (2025) and references therein). It is therefore a priori unknowable if and how the WMT26 gold standard differs from prior years’ ESA gold standards. Thus, an error-classifying threshold that may be optimal for our system for WMT25 data may not be entirely optimal for WMT26. As a consequence, we did not optimize our prompts to obtain maximum MCC when computed on earlier WMT development data, but rather to obtain a robustness plateau, that is, a range within which small variations in the error-classifying threshold lead to relatively minor changes in the MCC value. This can be observed in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 强健是什么意思? 以往的WPT任务使用标准误差跨度注释(ESA) Kocmi等人(2024年),准则和锚定规格略有不同(例如参见. Lavie等人(2025年)及其参考文献)。 因此,WMT26金本位是否和如何与往年欧空局的金本位标准不同是不可推论的。 因此,可能对我们的WMT25数据系统来说最理想的错分类阈值可能不完全适合WMT26。 因此,我们在计算早期的WMT开发数据时,没有优化我们获得最大MCC的提示,而是获得坚固性高原,即误差分类阈值的微小变化导致MCC值变化较小的范围。 这可以从图1中看出。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows two different systems with similar ROC performance, but quite different MCC versus threshold behavior. Example Systems A and B have comparable ROC curves and ROC-AUC values, but their MCC versus QE threshold behavior differs. While System A has a slightly lower best MCC value compared to System B, the peak of System A’s MCC distribution is decidedly broader than that of System B.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了两个具有相似ROC性能的不同系统,但MCC相对于阈值行为却截然不同. 示例系统 A和B具有可比较的ROC曲线和ROC-AUC值,但其MCC与QE阈值行为不同. 系统 与System B相比,A的MCC最高值略低于System B,System A的MCC分布峰值肯定比System B要宽。

blocks.en: 3 Our System Engineering Approach
blocks.zh: 3. 我们的系统工程方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Sample Data and Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.1 样本数据和基线

blocks.en: For the prompt engineering iterations described in the next subsection, we used data from past Conferences on Machine Translation (WMT) that were available in a public GitHub repository https://github.com/googleresearch/mt-metrics-eval , licensed under Apache v2.0. Specifically, we used the English into Chinese data with ESA annotations from WMT25 Lavie et al. (2025) , and the English into German data from WMT23 in the same repository that were supplemented with ESA annotations by Kocmi et al. (2024) ; Zouhar et al. (2024) . These ESA annotations for English into German WMT23 data are available at https://github.com/wmt-conference/errorspanannotation . For our prompt iterations, we split each of these datasets into a development set containing approximately 70% of the en → \rightarrow zh and en → \rightarrow de datasets, respectively, and a test set containing the remaining 30%.
blocks.zh: 关于下一小节中描述的即时工程迭代,我们使用了在Apache v2.0许可的GitHub公共仓库https://github.com/googleresearch/mt-meters-eval中提供的以往机器翻译会议的数据。 具体地说,我们用WMT25 Lavie等人(2025年)的欧空局说明将英文输入中文数据,用WMT23在同一寄存器中提供的英文输入德文数据,Kocmi等人(2024年);Zouhar等人(2024年)补充了欧空局的说明。 欧空局关于将数据译成德国WMT23的这些说明见https://github.com/wmt-conference/errorspanannotation。 对于我们的快速迭代,我们把这些数据集分成一个开发集,其中分别包含大约70%的en \ 右侧zh和en \ 右侧的datas集,以及一个包含其余30%的测试集。

blocks.en: Our main gold standard was defined in a manner similar to WMT26 subtask 3: An error-free segment is defined as having an ESA score ≥ \geq 85 and no error span annotation. Where two sets of human annotations were available, we took the average of the ESA scores ≥ \geq 85, and either no error span annotation in annotation set 1 or no error span annotation in set 2. It turned out that our relative screening method via ROC analysis is relatively robust to changes in the definition of the gold standard.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要金本位定义方式与WMT26子任务3类似:一个无误段被定义为有 =\ geq 85 的欧空局分数,没有差错跨注. 在有两套人文说明的情况下,我们采用了欧空局的平均值 \\ geq 85,或者在注释集1中无差错横跨注释,或者在注释集中无差错横跨注释 2. 国家 结果发现,通过ROC分析,我们的相对筛选方法相对来说对金本位定义的变化来说是比较有力的.

blocks.en: And finally, to study an example of an ultra-low-resource language for subtask 3, we used the English into Northern Sámi recipe wmt26-eng-sme from the WMT26 General MT task datasets. From this recipe, we created a somewhat artificial development set as follows: We randomly selected 2000 longer segments from the recipe, then randomly selected 1000 segments from these as an error-free gold standard, and modified the other 1000 segments with random punctuation errors, omissions and additions of random words in Northern Sámi, as well as random source text insertions to obtain 1000 error-containing gold standard segments. Of course, this is nowhere near equivalent to a real development dataset, but given the fact that none of the authors speaks Northern Sámi, this is the closest available approximation.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了研究一个实例 超低资源语言 对于子任务3, 我们使用英语 北萨米食谱wmt26 -eng -sme 从 WMT26 General MT任务数据集。 从这个配方中,我们创造了一个有点人为的发展模式如下: 我们从食谱中随机选择2000个更长的片段,然后从这些片段中随机选择1000个片段,作为无错误的金本位标准,并修改了其他1000个片段,在北萨米语中随机的标注错误,遗漏和添加随机的单词,以及随机的源文字插入,以获得1000个含有错误的金本位标准片段. 当然,这与真正的开发数据集相差甚远,但鉴于没有一个作者会说北萨米语,这是现有最接近的近似值。

blocks.en: As our baselines, we ran CometKiwi22 Rei et al. (2022) and xCOMET-XL Guerreiro et al. (2023) on these development and test data.
blocks.zh: 作为我们的基线,我们对这些开发和测试数据进行了CometKiwi22 Rei等人(2022年)和xCOMET-XL Guerreiro等人(2023年)的研究。

blocks.en: For testing and developing prompts for English into Northern Sámi, we also utilized the open-source LLM NorMistral-11B Samuel et al. (2025b) ; Samuel et al. (2025a) , with prompts in the Norwegian language instead of English.
blocks.zh: 在测试和开发英语的提示到北萨米语时,我们还使用了开源LLM NorMistral-11B Samuel et al. (2025b) ; Samuel et al. (2025a) , 以挪威语而不是英语为辅音.

blocks.en: 3.2 Iterative Prompt Engineering
blocks.zh: 3.2 迭代即时工程

blocks.en: Our prompt engineering approach was iterative, discarding prompts that are no better than our baselines, while attempting to improve the promising ones that exhibited the best ROC-AUC performance. Once this iteration converged to a few prompts with similar ROC performance, we selected those that showed a robust MCC performance as detailed in Section 2.2 . As our final system and system variants, we chose the ones that exhibited the minimum cost and latency. This highly efficient approach can be automated and easily adapted to other scenarios outside the WMT realm.
blocks.zh: 我们的迅速工程方法是迭代的,抛弃了不比我们的基线更好的提示,同时试图改进展现出最佳ROC-AUC业绩的有希望的提示。 一旦这种迭代汇合到几个具有类似ROC性能的提示上,我们选定了那些表现出强烈的MCC性能,详见第2.2节。 作为我们最后的系统和系统变体,我们选择了那些表现出最低成本和耐久性的系统。 这种高效的方法可以自动化,并易于适应WPT领域之外的其他情景。

blocks.en: We experimented with a variety of prompts. On the basis on linguistic and other technical considerations, we identified six distinct main strategies. After performing ROC analysis on the results, we discarded those that were clearly inferior. On the prompts that seemed promising, we iterated a number of times, incorporating various refinements. Our findings are reported in the next section.
blocks.zh: 我们尝试了各种诱因。 基于语言和其他技术考虑,我们确定了六项不同的主要战略。 在对结果进行ROC分析后,我们放弃了那些明显低劣的结果。 关于似乎很有希望的提示,我们多次重复,包括各种改进。 下一节报告我们的调查结果。

blocks.en: 4 Submitted Systems
blocks.zh: 4 提交系统

blocks.en: Using the aforementioned iterative prompt engineering approach, we were able to answer some of the questions in Section 2.1 and converge on a final system. The one question we were unable to answer is whether the newest models, which were presumably trained on the largest and most recent training data, are able to handle ultra-low-resource languages better than slightly older models, given the same prompt. This led us to submit two system variants to subtask 2 (see Table 1 ), the primary system using the same cost-efficient general-purpose model for all languages, and a variant using one of the newest available models for the three language pairs English into Ladin, Ligurian, and Northern Sámi. The official results of subtask 2 will tell which option is better.
blocks.zh: 采用上述迭代即时工程方法,我们得以回答第2.1节中的一些问题,并就一个最后系统达成一致。 我们无法回答的一个问题是,最新的模型,大概是接受过最大和最新培训数据培训的模型,在同样迅速的情况下,是否能够更好地处理超低资源语言。 这使得我们向次级任务2(见表1)提交了两个系统变体,即对所有语言使用同样具有成本效益的通用模式的初级系统,以及使用英语三种语言对称的最新可用模式之一的变体,进入拉丁语、利古里安语和北萨米语。 子任务2的官方结果将显示哪个选项更好.

blocks.en: As a side note, while we used NorMistral-11B for testing and development, we did not end up incorporating it into our system framework. This is because we did not perform a separate prompt engineering optimization for Northern Sámi, in part because Norwegian seems to be a better prompting language for NorMistral-11B than English, and none of the authors speaks Norwegian. With the same prompt as for all the other languages, the commercial general purpose models we studied seem to perform better on our artificial mock dataset for Northern Sámi, but this may well be because the prompt was optimized for these models, not for NorMistral-11B, or perhaps because our artificial mock dataset is constructed somewhat arbitrarily, or a combination of both.
blocks.zh: 顺便说一句,虽然我们使用NorMistral-11B进行测试和开发,但最终没有将其纳入我们的系统框架。 这是因为我们没有为Northern Sámi进行单独的即时工程优化,部分原因是挪威语似乎比英语更适合NorMistral-11B的促动语言,没有一位作者会说挪威语. 与所有其他语言一样,我们所研究的商业通用模型似乎在北萨米的人工模拟数据集上表现得更好,但这很可能是因为对这些模型的及时性得到了优化,而不是NorMistral-11B,或者也许是因为我们人工模拟数据集的构建有些武断,或者两者兼而有之。

blocks.en: The final selected prompt instructs the LLM to evaluate the translation quality for each segment individually, without requiring the model to identify specific translation errors or to justify its score. Figure 2 shows the selected system’s ROC curve compared to our baselines, CometKiwi22 and xCOMET-XL, on the WMT25 English into Chinese data. Figure 2 also lists the corresponding ROC-AUC values with their 95% confidence intervals. Figure 3 shows the selected system’s MCC versus threshold behavior.
blocks.zh: 最终选定的即时指示LLM单独评价每个部分的翻译质量,而不要求模型识别具体的翻译错误或证明其得分的理由. 图2显示所选系统的ROC曲线与我们的基线(CometKiwi22和xCOMET-XL)相比,在WMT25英文上输入中文数据. 图2还列出了相应的ROC-AUC值,其置信间隔为95%. 图3显示所选系统的MCC相对于阈值行为.

blocks.en: Figure 2: ROC curve of the chosen prompt and model combination compared to the baselines CometKiwi22 and xCOMET-XL on the WMT25 en → \rightarrow zh dataset.
blocks.zh: 图2:与WMT25 en \rightarrow zh数据集上的CometKiwi22和xCOMET-XL基线相比,所选快速组合和模型组合的ROC曲线。

blocks.en: Figure 3: MCC versus error-classifying threshold curve for the selected system on the WMT25 en → \rightarrow zh dataset. The red diamond indicates the maximum MCC value.
blocks.zh: 图3 MCC 相对于 WMT25 en →\rightarrow zh数据集中选定系统的误分类阈值曲线. 红钻表示最大中导电荷值.

blocks.en: We ran our scoring in batches of up to 20 segments produced by the same MT system for the same language pair, because this batching procedure leads to lower token usage and cost.
blocks.zh: 我们用相同的MT系统为同一种语言对子生产的最多20个部分进行分数,因为这种分数程序导致象征性使用率和成本降低。

blocks.en: For subtask 3, we submitted two system variants that are derived from Pterodactyl and specifically optimized for subtask 3, employing a threshold-setting strategy based on patterns observed in the WMT25 data.
blocks.zh: 关于次级任务3,我们提交了两个系统变体,这些变体来自Pterodactyl,并特别优化了次级任务3,采用了基于WMT25数据所观察到的规律的门槛设定策略.

blocks.en: Table 1 gives an overview of our primary system and its variant that were submitted to subtasks 2 and 3, along with the computational cost involved in scoring the official WMT26 test data. Table 2 lists the variants we submitted specifically to subtask 3.
blocks.zh: 表1概述了我们向次级任务2和3提交的初级系统及其变体,以及正式的WMT26测试数据评分所涉及的计算费用。 表2列出了我们具体提交给第3分任务的变体。

blocks.en: Table 1: Systems submitted by 1020 Group to WMT26 subtasks 2 and 3, along with the computational cost involved in scoring the official WMT26 test data.
blocks.zh: 表1:1020 Group提交WMT26子任务2和3的系统,以及评分WMT26正式测试数据所涉及的计算成本.

blocks.en: Table 2: Systems submitted by 1020 Group to WMT26 subtask 3. No additional LLM-computational cost is involved, since the scores are taken from the main Pterodactyl scoring run and subsequently converted into a binary classification for subtask 3 via Python.
blocks.zh: 表2:1020 Group提交WMT26子任务的系统 3. 不涉及额外的LLM-计算成本,因为分数取自主Pterodactyl积分运行,之后通过Python转换为子任务3的二进制分类.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Outlook
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和展望

blocks.en: Pterodactyl’s central design principle was deliberate minimalism: use no more model or engineering complexity than the task requires. Our submission to subtasks 2 and 3 of the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach. Our prompt engineering and model selection process uses ROC analysis as a screening tool, making the development highly adaptable, robust, and low-cost. It remains to be seen, however, whether this minimal approach is an effective alternative to fine-tuning or building from scratch. The shared-task results will show whether Pterodactyl merely costs less—or whether it offers a genuinely competitive alternative to more resource-intensive system development.
blocks.zh: Pterodactyl的中央设计原则是故意的最小化:不使用比任务要求更多的模型或工程复杂性. 我们向WPT26分任务2和3提交的有关自动化质量评价的共同任务,是以作为法官的LLM方法为基础的。 我们的快速工程和模型选择过程将ROC分析作为筛选工具,使开发具有高度适应性,强健性和低成本. 然而,这一最低限度的办法是否是微调或从零开始建设的有效替代办法,仍有待观察。 共同任务的结果将显示Pterodactyl是否仅仅成本较低,或者它是否为资源密集型的系统开发提供了真正具有竞争力的替代办法。

blocks.en: The astute reader will of course observe that we have committed the cardinal sin of extrapolating from not necessarily representative development data into the great unknown of WMT26, which includes new language pairs and a novel human annotation scheme. But this leap of faith is not entirely unfounded, based on high-level patterns we observed across languages and domains from the WMT25 and WMT23 data, supplemented by our “artificial” Northern Sámi data. In an actual production environment, such an extrapolation is of course unnecessary, and the system can easily be adapted to real in-domain and in-language data for production scenarios, as described above.
blocks.zh: 当然,精明的读者会注意到,我们犯下了从不一定具有代表性的发展数据推断出WMT26这一大未知数的罪魁祸首,其中包括新的语言配对和新的人类注释计划。 但这种信仰的飞跃并不是完全没有根据的,基于我们从WMT25和WMT23数据中观察到的跨语言和领域的高级别模式,再加上我们的“人工”的北萨米数据。 在实际生产环境中,这种推算当然是不必要的,如上所述,系统可以很容易地适应生产情景的实际域内和语言数据.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: As already mentioned, the exact human gold standard for WMT26 is unknowable, because in prior WMT tasks, standard ESA was employed, whereas this year’s task utilizes contrastive ESA for the first time. However, this unknown factor is the same for all participants, and it remains to be seen what, if any, effects the new human annotation scheme has on the results. Another unknown is how this year’s test dataset, including the addition of new language pairs without human-annotated data, differs from those of previous years. Again, all participants are in the same boat here. Finally, our system was developed with rather limited resources, and we tested only on two language pairs with ESA annotations. Further studies are needed to show whether our one-size-fits-all system really does fit all.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,WMT26精确的人类金本位标准是不可知晓的,因为在以往WMT任务中,采用了标准的欧空局,而今年的任务首次使用了具有对比性的欧空局。 然而,对所有参与者来说,这一未知因素是一样的,而新的人类注解办法对结果有何影响,仍有待观察。 另一个未知之处是,今年的测试数据集,包括添加没有人类附加说明的新语言对,与往年的数据有何不同. 同样,所有参与者都在同一艘船上。 最后,我们的系统是用相当有限的资源开发的,我们只在两种语言上进行了测试,并附有欧空局的说明。 还需要进一步研究,以显示我们的“一刀切”系统是否真正适合所有人。

blocks.en: Acknowledgments
blocks.zh: 承认

blocks.en:
If we score higher, it is because we have the privilege of choosing which giants’ shoulders we stand on. We are deeply grateful to those who made that choice possible.
We also thank Prof. Alon Lavie for encouraging us, and the WMT organizers for enabling us to participate and for openly providing past years? data for development purposes.
blocks.zh:
如果我们得分更高,那是因为我们有幸选择我们站在哪个巨人的肩膀上。 我们对作出这一选择的人深表感谢。
我们还感谢教授。 Alon Lavie鼓励我们,而WMT组织者让我们能够参与并公开提供过去几年的服务? 用于发展目的的数据。
